title: Fresh yellow curb lines marking the kill zone on Elm Street

tellings.quote: Did you know that there were three yellow painted lines right on the side of the curb where the shot in in conjunction where all the shots took place in the in the kill zone and they were painted the night before cuz Beverly Oliver was standing on one.

plain: Three yellow lines are said to have been painted on the curb of Elm Street in Dallas the night before President Kennedy was shot in 1963, right where the shots were fired. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this without naming a source. He says Beverly Oliver, a witness to the shooting, was standing on one of the lines and points to the Zapruder film, the home movie of the killing. If it is true, someone had marked out the kill zone ahead of time.
